items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: I know one time old man Glenny was playing a three string bass.

ctx.x: I don't know. I was going to ask about the three string bass in the old days. I know one time old man Glenny was playing a three string bass. Do you know if your father always played four strings? Four.
He always had four. Never played three. Never played a three. That's the advantage of over a tree, you see? You go to hit a pedal note below the staff, how you going to hit it? You got three strings.
